summary: Planted change c32-plant (SPEC3 F9; never merged: orch/automerge.sh refuses rbd-plant PRs): payments RiskCheck: +3 ms sleep (mechanism sleep; placement: top of RiskCheck, before its first statement: every call (before any cache lookup or early return)).
